hero.lead: WellSpend Budget Tracker is a calm, beautiful budget tracker for real life. Income, expenses, bills, goals and insights — everything in one place, for less than a bottle of water.
hero.note: One-time $1 payment · Every feature unlocked forever · Paynow, card, Ecocash or bank.

features.heading: Everything you need
features.sub: Six focused tools that cover your whole financial life — no bloat, no learning curve.

budget.title: Budget Planner
budget.text: Set monthly budgets per category and watch your spend track against them in real time.

savings.title: Savings Goals
savings.text: Define goals with deadlines and see exactly how far along each one is.

bills.title: Bills & Reminders
bills.text: Never miss a due date — upcoming, paid and overdue bills in one glance.

reports.title: Reports & Analytics
reports.text: Income vs expenses, category breakdowns and trends that actually make sense.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.text: Ask questions about your money in plain language and get instant answers.

safe.title: Safe to Spend
safe.text: See the exact amount that''s safe to spend today after bills and goals are covered.

rollover.title: Rollover & Sinking Funds
rollover.text: Leftover budget rolls into next month — and side-pots build up for the big, rare expenses.

currency.title: Every Currency
currency.text: USD, ZWG, ZAR and every ISO currency — your money, your format.

reminders.title: Bills Never Late
reminders.text: Renewal warnings before a subscription or bill charges you — no surprise deductions.

how.heading: Up and running in a minute
how.sub: Three steps between you and a clear picture of your money.

account.title: Create your account
account.text: Sign up with your name and email — it takes thirty seconds.

pay.title: Pay $1 once
pay.text: One dollar. Once. Paynow, card, Ecocash or bank transfer — your pick.

currency.title: Pick your currency
currency.text: USD, ZWG, ZAR and every ISO currency — set once, formatted everywhere.

budgets.title: Set your budgets
budgets.text: Give each category a monthly number — that''s your spending plan done.

accounts.title: Add your accounts
accounts.text: Bank, EcoCash, cash — list where your money actually lives.

log.title: Log as you spend
log.text: A few seconds per entry — or bulk-import a statement CSV.

watch.title: Watch it add up
watch.text: Charts, bills, safe-to-spend — the dashboard keeps you honest.

own.title: Own your money
own.text: Full access forever. Every feature, every update, no subscriptions.

business.heading: Unified HR Solutions
business.line: Payroll · Leave · Claims · Loans · People — all in one place.
business.sub: Shop, clinic, school, NGO or startup — if you pay people, WellSpend works for you. Every person on your team gets their own money app, and people who can manage their pay, stay.
business.staffK: of staff get the app free
business.payText: Pick a date, check the list, press pay. Bonuses and fixes go in a quick extra run — done.
business.staffText: Payslips, leave requests and advances happen in each person''s own app. No more WhatsApping HR for a payslip.
business.awayTitle: See who''s off, at a glance
business.awayText: Approve leave in one tap and everyone sees the same who''s-away calendar. No double-booking, no surprises.
business.loansText: Staff apply, you approve, and repayments come off their payslip on their own. No chasing, no spreadsheets.
business.accessText: Give HR, accounts and managers their own access — pay info stays private, approvals stay in order.
business.fileText: Download one file for your bank or EcoCash for Business and the whole team is paid. That''s payday, finished.
business.note: Any size, any industry — tell us about your business and we''ll have your team up and running within a day.

pricing.heading: One dollar. That''s it.
pricing.sub: No subscriptions, no tiers, no upsells. Pay once, keep it forever.
